programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "New Orleans"
programs.desc: CGI peels back the Superdome and the city’s silt to reveal the massive pumps and barriers keeping New Orleans from sinking.

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "New York"
programs.desc: Dissecting New York's stone and steel, CGI reveals the inflatable subway plugs and bedrock foundations shielding the city from Atlantic superstorms.

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "Paris"
programs.desc: Using a virtual scalpel, CGI strips the Eiffel Tower to its 17-foot base and peels back the boulevards to expose 180 miles of ancient quarries.

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "Tokyo"
programs.desc: Stripping Tokyo to its steel and rock, CGI peels back the glass to reveal the mega-quake technology keeping this futuristic metropolis standing.

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "Venice"
programs.desc: CGI strips the marble from Saint Mark’s and peels back the canals to reveal the 400-year-old foundations keeping sinking Venice afloat.

programs.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Mardi Gras, Rock Candy, Dentures"
programs.desc: A look at how the amazing, and massive, decorations on Mardi Gras carnival floats are created, how rock candy is twisted together, and a look at how dentures are made.
